invariants.rationale: MathUtils.clamp with lower bound 0 ensures result never negative.
MathUtils.clamp with upper bound 1 ensures result never exceeds 1.
If maxX == 0, result is 0; otherwise, it is the clamped ratio.
If maxX == 0, result is forcibly set to 0.
Due to clamping, if result is nonzero, the unclamped ratio must be at least 0.
